Lumu’s platform fulfills SecOps requirements by bringing together visibility, automation, compliance, and intelligence— enabling a proactive and adaptable cybersecurity strategy.

Lumu Report on Cybersecurity for Education 2026 

Schools are now the primary objective for cybercrime in the USA. Attackers are taking advantage of the chaos of student traffic to get into your network. 
Access Report ⇁

Attacks 
Advisory Alert: AsyncRAT – Analysis, Evolution, and Defense Strategies 

AsyncRAT is an adaptable open-source Trojan that has evolved into a global threat. We look at how it works and the best way to defend against it.
